avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction reduces avatrombopag plasma concentrations and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; if necessary, consult prescriber for dose adjustment

avoid_supplements.name: Grapefruit Seed Extract
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases avatrombopag concentrations and thrombotic risk
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue use; maintain consistent grapefruit avoidance throughout treatment

caution_supplements.name: Turmeric (Curcumin)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential CYP3A4 inhibition and platelet aggregation effects may potentiate thrombosis risk
caution_supplements.action: Monitor platelet counts; limit doses to <1g daily if used

caution_supplements.name: Garlic Supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild antiplatelet effects may additively increase bleeding risk in thrombocytopenia patients
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for unusual bleeding; use moderate doses only

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and Grapefruit Juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition significantly elevates avatrombopag levels, increasing thrombotic complications
avoid_foods.action: Eliminate from diet; educate patient on hidden grapefruit in juices and supplements

caution_foods.name: High-Fat Meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May delay avatrombopag absorption and alter pharmacokinetics
caution_foods.action: Administer with consistent meal patterns; avoid excessive dietary fat fluctuations

monitoring_notes: Monitor platelet counts regularly during therapy, particularly if CYP3A4/2C8 inhibitors or inducers are initiated. Assess for signs of thrombosis (pain, swelling, shortness of breath) as avatrombopag carries inherent thrombotic risk that may be potentiated by drug interactions.
